title: CODA THE WHITE NOISE (Ambient Techno × Drone) [122]
style: ambient techno meets ambient drone, 122 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English + Japanese + te reo Maori, sparse minimal techno kick, glacial evolving pads, granular texture beds, white noise sweeps as a featured element, deep modular sub bass, soft tape hiss, slow filter automation, distant Rhodes piano motif, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, listening-room quiet-introspection mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, audiophile 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(white noise sweep, glacial pad swell, distant Rhodes)
(CO... DA... white... noise...)
(shi... zu... ka... ni...)
(ma... ru... ie... ie...)

[Build]
(minimal kick enters sparse, sub bass slides up)
CO — DA! WHITE — NOISE!
SHI — ZU — KA — NI!
MA — RU — IE!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(filter sweep opens, soft riser)

[Drop 1]
(four-on-the-floor sparse kick, granular textures bloom)
CO — DA!
WHITE — NOISE!
QUI — ET!
SIG — NAL!
(chop stack +7) hai-hai-yes-yes / āe-āe-hai-hai
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(kick drops to half, Rhodes solo phrase, chops trade)
(kikoeru?) (hear it?) (kei te rongo?)
(hai!) (yes!) (āe!)
(shizuka ni!) (quietly!) (mārie!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE SILENCE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to drone + tape hiss, no kick)
(whispered) coda... white... noise...
(soft) shizuka... ni...
(soft) mārie... ie...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(white noise sweep builds, kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(layered kick + sub, granular bloom peak)
CO — DA — WHITE — NOISE! (hai hai hai!)
SHI — ZU — KA — NI! (āe āe āe!)
QUI — ET — SIG — NAL!
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(kick fades, drone holds, white noise sweep)
(coda... white... noise...)
(shizuka... ni...)
(mārie... ie...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(drone holds long, fade to silence)
